publisher: Groundwater Surveys and Development Agency (GSDA), Government of Maharashtra, via the National Water Data Portal

method.signConvention: Source values are negative metres; NWDP describes them as groundwater depth below the surface. Shown here as positive depth.
method.validRange: 0 < depth <= 200 m; other readings excluded and counted
method.daily: median of the day's six-hourly readings (timestamps as published, assumed IST)
method.spikes: daily value dropped if more than max(3 x scaled MAD, 1 m) from the median of the surrounding +/-3 days
method.current: median of the last 3 clean days; station 'current' if that is within 7 days of the dataset's last observation
method.change30d: current depth minus the median of clean days 30+/-3 days earlier; positive = water further down
method.vsMay: May median depth minus current depth (needs 10+ clean May days); positive = water higher than before the monsoon
method.trend: falling / rising when the 30-day change exceeds 0.5 m; otherwise steady
method.erratic: more than 20% of readings excluded or 20% of days flagged as spikes; left out of district medians
method.flat: clean readings varied less than 0.1 m over the last 90 days; the well may be dry below the sensor or the sensor stuck. Shown with a note and kept in medians
